name: Atombit
blog_profile: Atombit operates through specialized sub-brands (Profusion for data science/AI, Amplify Analytix for analytics) targeting financial services with GenAI-powered customer intelligence and predictive modeling. Their methodology centers on data-driven segmentation, next-best-action frameworks, and real-time decisioning engines for banking and insurance verticals. Delivery model combines EU and India-based teams for scalable analytics engagements. Thought leadership emphasizes practical AI application in regulated industries rather than platform-specific partnerships.

name: Sovanta
blog_profile: Sovanta positions as the premier bridge between SAP operational data and Qualtrics experience data, with deep specialization in embedded analytics and AI agent integration within SAP BTP environments. Their methodology focuses on closing the experience-operations gap through real-time dashboards, automated workflows, and predictive analytics embedded directly in SAP user interfaces. Delivery model is DACH-anchored with expanding EU reach, targeting manufacturing and financial services enterprises. Thought leadership consistently emphasizes practical AI deployment within existing SAP landscapes rather than standalone CX platforms.

name: New Metrics
blog_profile: New Metrics specializes in GCC public sector CX transformation with deep Qualtrics implementation expertise aligned to national digital transformation agendas (Vision 2030, UAE Smart Government). Their methodology centers on citizen experience maturity frameworks, journey mapping for government services, and data-driven feedback loops. Delivery model is GCC-anchored with global advisory capabilities. Thought leadership themes focus on public sector CX benchmarking, digital government experience design, and Arabic-language CX program localization.

name: Ipsos CX
blog_profile: Ipsos CX leverages its global research infrastructure to deliver CX measurement, benchmarking, and strategic advisory at enterprise scale. Their methodology combines proprietary research frameworks with Medallia platform expertise to quantify experience ROI and loyalty economics. Delivery model is truly global with local market research capabilities across 90+ countries. Thought leadership emphasizes evidence-based CX strategy, consumer trend analysis, and linking experience metrics to financial outcomes across retail and financial services.

name: commonFont
blog_profile: commonFont is a US-based Qualtrics specialist focused on enterprise CX program design, AI agent deployment, and experience orchestration for banking and financial services. Their methodology emphasizes end-to-end Qualtrics implementation, program optimization, and integrating AI-driven insights into operational workflows. Delivery model is US-centric with deep Qualtrics platform certification and hands-on implementation expertise. Thought leadership themes consistently address practical Qualtrics AI agent use cases, financial services CX maturity, and experience data-to-action frameworks.

name: Higher Oak
blog_profile: Higher Oak is a UK/EU-based Qualtrics Platinum Partner historically focused on enterprise experience management program design and Qualtrics platform implementation. Their methodology has centered on strategic CX consulting, platform configuration, and program optimization for mid-to-large enterprises. The prolonged content absence raises questions about potential organizational changes, strategic repositioning, or internal transitions that may be affecting their external-facing thought leadership activities.

name: Lukkap
blog_profile: Lukkap is a Spain/LATAM-based CX and EX consultancy with a platform-agnostic approach to customer journey transformation and organizational change management. Their methodology integrates employee experience design with customer journey mapping, emphasizing human-centered transformation rather than technology-first approaches. Delivery model spans Spain and Latin American markets with Spanish-language content and regional consulting teams. Thought leadership themes consistently address the intersection of EX and CX, journey-centric design, and cultural change management in enterprise transformations.

name: Izo
blog_profile: Izo is an Iberoamerican CX consultancy with Qualtrics certification operating across 15+ Spanish-speaking markets. Their methodology encompasses CX strategy, Voice of Customer program design, digital experience optimization, and customer journey management. Delivery model leverages regional presence across Spain and Latin America with localized consulting teams. Thought leadership focuses on enterprise CX maturity, VoC best practices, and digital experience transformation within Spanish-speaking markets, positioning as the go-to Qualtrics partner for Iberoamerican enterprises.

name: Globant
blog_profile: Globant is a global technology services company positioning AI engineering and generative AI as the central narrative across all studios including Connected Experiences. Their CX methodology is embedded within broader digital transformation and AI adoption programs rather than standalone experience management consulting. Delivery model is global at scale with large engineering teams across Latin America, Europe, and North America. CX thought leadership is subsumed within AI-first messaging, making it difficult to distinguish dedicated CX positioning from the overall corporate technology transformation narrative.

name: GemSeek
blog_profile: GemSeek fue absorbida por Accenture Song. Su propuesta original era analytics de CX con foco en predicción de churn y modelado de lealtad — un enfoque data science-first dentro del espacio CX. Sin actividad independiente desde la adquisición.
